title: A lapsing session warns, then re-signs in over the page instead of 'not permitted'
deviations_from_card: (1) Tests and code in ONE feat commit (a004d488d), not test-then-feat: the three test files cannot load before their modules exist, so a test-only commit would be red. Test-first order was kept in the working tree: 18 test cases red before any production code (sessionLapse 11 + sharedGet 3 as load failures, route 4 as assertion failures). Acceptance 0 of 8 before, 8 of 8 after (case 8 = i18n:check, exit 0). (2) Added a pure reconcileRead() (not in the card): a clock-due expiry re-reads /api/me/capabilities before prompting, so a re-sign-in in another tab is adopted rather than nagged about, and clock skew cannot produce a false lapse; a skew-contradicted expiry re-reads at most once a minute. Also parseSessionFacts() for the wire. (3) phaseAt returns live/no-timer for passwordMode with session null too (demo / anonymous), and the route returns session null for the demo workspace and for an identity-less non-operator cookie, not only for open mode. (4) The 'Stay signed in' chip action OPENS the re-auth dialog; it never calls switch-workspace or anything else that would renew a live cookie without a password. (5) resolveSwitch reloads '/' on ANY non-2xx (incl. network failure = status 0), and after a successful switch the facts are re-read and resolveReauth must say resume, otherwise reload. (6) Reload is a hard window.location.assign('/') (the leaveWorkspace idiom) - eslint warns (@next/next/no-location-assign-relative-destination, warning not error), deliberate: a client push would keep the previous person's mounted state. (7) The dialog reuses login.* catalog keys for its fields, submit and error toasts; only 11 new keys in a new sessionLapse namespace. (8) perf-budget.json raised app/page.tsx 1392 -> 1396 modules (+4: sessionLapse.ts, useSessionLapse.ts, SessionLapseDialog.tsx, the reused login/login-result.ts) under the lock; KB ceiling not raised (my share +24.5 KB fit in the 8744 ceiling at the time).
notes: Card write set shrunk: nothing else touched beyond it + 2 test files (sharedGet.test.ts, which the card's case 7 implies) + perf-budget.json under the lock. Sign-in goes ONLY through POST /api/auth/login (which issues through session-issuer.ts); the switch-back path calls the re-validating switch-workspace door from slot A. tsc: all errors are foreign (kpi-sim/ untracked tree; sibling in-flight app/features/shell/simulation/*, GithubAnalysisPanel.tsx, analytics-cache.test.ts, analytics-job-cohort.test.ts); zero on my files. Full npm run test:unit exit 1 ONLY on app/features/insights/analytics/analyticsRenderMap.test.ts (BROKEN, 2 cases) - the analytics-dashboard sibling's uncommitted work, not a file I touch or import. test:perf: measured on git-archive trees (no sibling uncommitted files): committed 2592b71c8 = 1392 modules / 8927064 B, + my files = 1396 / 8952131 B (8742 KB) -> green after my raise.
